description: The Act metadata describes mandatory warranties for new homes with permits obtained from February 1, 2014, including single-family and multifamily homes, duplexes, condominiums, manufactured homes and recreational properties. It lists minimum coverage of one year for labour and materials, two years for delivery/distribution systems, five years for the building envelope and ten years for major structural components. These are source-stated building-system liability periods, not physical asset lifetimes or observed failure probabilities. The legal-publication URI has no stated file format or edition.
